easyPrerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {C}{C}
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Carnival of Souls triggers, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.name: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel
